about: Zenkai Rules Z1 intent examples for PAR-hollow-pass's outcome check (night-1 triage rank 2, scratchpad/night1-parity-install-guide-triage.md, row 488): a layer 6 parity pair where BOTH sides fail the SAME way used to score a pass (envelopes_match alone can't tell a genuine pass from an identical refusal on both sides). Provisional pending Pratik: gated behind policy flag parity.same_failure_is_pass (tests/gauntlet/data/check_map.json's flags list), default off/false, so a one-line config flip restores the old scoring. Run by gauntlet/tests/test_evaluate.py and tests/gauntlet/test_exec_parity.py (two independent parts of the same fix: the flag the evaluator reads, and the flag exec_parity.parity_pair computes).
subject: gauntlet/evaluate.py evaluate() + Policy.flags; tests/gauntlet/exec_parity.py parity_pair

examples.source: night1-parity-install-guide-triage.md PAR-hollow-pass: 'the layer's only check is envelopes_match ... which holds whenever MCP and CLI agree, including when both fail the same way. So the 77 passes overstate coverage.' Needs Pratik section item 1.
a genuine pair (the verb ran identically on both sides) must not regress -- only the SAME-FAILURE case changes
brief: 'implement it behind a flag parity.same_failure_is_pass defaulting to false so a one-line config flip restores the old scoring'
